nodes.label: Favicon (src/app/icon.png)
nodes.rationale: Uses mark only because the lockup is illegible at 32px.

nodes.label: Logo Lockup (hero)
nodes.rationale: Lockup trimmed so it fills its frame in the hero.

nodes.label: next/image Path-Based Cache
nodes.rationale: next/image caches by path, not content, so .next/cache/images must be cleared after regenerating logos.

nodes.label: AI Crawlers Named in robots.txt
nodes.rationale: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended etc. are named explicitly rather than relying on the blanket * allow.

nodes.label: Contact Email CTA (hello@46dogs.com, SITE.email)
nodes.rationale: No email-capture form; launch list was removed so every CTA points at one email set in SITE.email.

nodes.label: /llms.txt Brief
nodes.rationale: Flat-markdown brief for LLMs with facts, FAQ, and a citation note not to call 46 Dogs a registered charity since registration is still in progress.

nodes.label: Master Logo (public/logo.png)
nodes.rationale: Everything visual is derived from one file; it stays untouched as the master and is what the NGO schema points at.

nodes.label: Answer-Engine Discoverability
nodes.rationale: Built to be quoted by AI answer engines, not just ranked by Google.

nodes.label: Linked JSON-LD via @id
nodes.rationale: Blocks are cross-referenced by @id so a crawler reads one entity rather than three unrelated islands.

nodes.label: Pure-Monochrome Theme
nodes.rationale: Theme colors are taken directly from the black-and-white 46DOGS logo.

nodes.label: Server-Rendered FAQ (native details)
nodes.rationale: Native <details> keeps answer text in the HTML whether or not a crawler runs JavaScript.

nodes.label: Single Source of Truth for Copy (site.ts)
nodes.norm_label: single source of truth for copy (site.ts)
nodes.rationale: All copy, links and structured data live in src/lib/site.ts; JSON-LD, FAQ section, llms.txt and contact CTAs are built from the same constants so they can never drift apart.

nodes.label: 46DOGS Master Logo (logo.png)
nodes.description: 2048x2048 square master brand logo: white artwork on solid black. Stacked layout with a seated-dog mark above the 46DOGS wordmark and the tagline 'RESCUE. CARE. LOVE.'
nodes.rationale: Monochrome, high-contrast square master gives one source that a script can crop and recolor into favicon, app icon, OG card, mark and lockup variants. The large empty black margin leaves room to crop.

nodes.label: Dog-from-46 Numeral Mark
nodes.description: Seated dog in right-facing profile (floppy ear, eye, whisker dots). Its body is drawn from the digits '4' and '6': the 4 forms the haunch and the 6 forms the chest and front leg, and a curved white tail sweeps around the left side.
nodes.rationale: Merges the brand number into the dog so the symbol works alone at small sizes such as icons, and the name and image read as one.

nodes.label: Tagline: Rescue. Care. Love.
nodes.description: Small, widely spaced capitals 'RESCUE. CARE. LOVE.' that place the brand as a dog rescue and care organization.

nodes.label: apple-icon.png (Apple Touch Icon)
nodes.description: Square ~180x180 icon: white line-art silhouette of a seated dog (Labrador-like profile, head facing right, collar) on solid black, with the numerals '4' and '6' formed into the dog's chest and legs. Logo mark only, no wordmark.
nodes.rationale: Next.js app-router file convention: src/app/apple-icon.png is auto-emitted as <link rel=apple-touch-icon>. The 180px size matches the iOS home-screen icon. The opaque black background keeps iOS from filling transparency with black or white, and dropping the wordmark keeps the mark readable at small sizes.

nodes.label: 46DOGS Wordmark
nodes.description: Wide-tracked geometric sans-serif capitals reading '46DOGS', set below the mark.

nodes.label: Numeral-dog brand mark (46 forming a seated dog)
nodes.norm_label: numeral-dog brand mark (46 forming a seated dog)
nodes.rationale: Negative-space design merges the brand number with the subject (dogs), making the name and the mission one glyph.

nodes.label: Numeral-46-as-dog-silhouette motif
nodes.rationale: Negative-space design: a sitting dog (Labrador-like profile, floppy ear, looking right) whose body, legs and tail are formed by the stylized white numerals '4' and '6', fusing the brand name '46' and 'DOGS' into one glyph.

nodes.label: Dog-silhouette '46' numeral mark
nodes.rationale: Brand mark fuses the number 46 into a seated dog's body, tying the name to the dog-rescue mission.

nodes.label: 46DOGS Dog-and-46 Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: Brand monogram that merges the digits 4 and 6 into a seated dog outline. Monochrome white-on-black for high contrast.

nodes.norm_label: next.js app router icon file convention

nodes.label: 46DOGS Logo Mark (square icon)
nodes.rationale: Square, wordmark-free crop of the brand mark for compact placements (header/nav icon); monochrome white-on-black keeps it legible at small sizes.

nodes.label: 46DOGS Open Graph Share Card (og.png)
nodes.rationale: 1200x630 social share card: centered white-on-black 46DOGS logo lockup (sitting dog silhouette whose body forms the digits '4' and '6') above the wordmark '46DOGS' and tagline 'RESCUE. CARE. LOVE.'. Large black margins keep the mark legible at small thumbnail crops across social platforms; monochrome matches the source logo.
